snippet.title: Out of Sight: Stage Fright - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Join Sophie and Teddy on a brand new adventure when Out of Sight gets its first DLC!🌟
Out of Sight: Stage Fright will land in 2026 on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X/S and Nintendo Switch! 

Make sure to follow us on all platforms for more news! 🧸
